text: FolderDatabase only assigns a getter output when a row exists. FolderInfo sets numeric and Boolean defaults first; its UTF16 getter uses an empty local UTF8 value, while the direct char getter preserves the incoming output when no row exists. The tests check the JavaScript-facing defaults and stored empty/false rows. Setters use REPLACE, so empty values remain stored; automatic deletion and ClearFolderProperty were only review proposals. Preserve the exact wrapper boundary when describing a missing value. These tests do not establish native pointer-width safety, all SQL-error propagation or schema migration.
title: Distinguish missing Panorama folder properties from stored empty values
